args.summary: Deployment inventory failed to roll out revision 2 because the image 'incident-shop/app:2.0.0-rc1' could not be pulled from Docker Hub (ErrImagePull / pull access denied). Roll back deployment/inventory to revision 1 to resolve the issue.

action.rationale: Roll back deployment/inventory to its previous revision (revision 1) with working image docker.io/incident-shop/app:1.0.0.

claims.statement: The new revision pod for inventory fails to pull the container image due to missing repository/authorization access.
claims.quote: failed to pull and unpack image "docker.io/incident-shop/app:2.0.0-rc1": failed to resolve reference "docker.io/incident-shop/app:2.0.0-rc1": pull access denied, repository does not exist or may require authorization: server message: insufficient_scope: authorization failed
change from revision 1 to 2: inventory.env.APP_VERSION: '1.0.0' -> '2.0.0-rc1'; inventory.image: 'incident-shop/app:1.0.0' -> 'incident-shop/app:2.0.0-rc1'
claims.statement: Deployment inventory was recently updated from image incident-shop/app:1.0.0 to incident-shop/app:2.0.0-rc1.
